ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a central carbon atom, connected upward to a positively charged OH2 group; connected leftward to an N-H group, and this nitrogen is further connected to a benzene ring; connected rightward to another benzene ring. Therefore the SMILES is [OH2+]C(Nc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: First describe the image contents, then transcribe the molecule: identify the central carbon and its three visible substituents—[OH2+] above, N(H)-phenyl on the left, and phenyl on the right. Since the prompt says to ignore arrows, do not encode any transition-arrow information. Encode the central carbon as C with branches/attachments to [OH2+], Nc1ccccc1, and c1ccccc1, yielding [OH2+]C(Nc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一个中心碳原子，向上连接到带正电的 OH2 基团；向左连接到一个 N-H 基团，该氮再连接一个苯环；向右连接另一个苯环。图中还画有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。推理：只编码实际原子连接关系。中心碳写作 C，上方水合氧正离子写作 [OH2+] 并与中心碳相连；左侧取代基为 N(H)-phenyl，对应 Nc1ccccc1；右侧取代基为 phenyl，对应 c1ccccc1。因此 SMILES 为 [OH2+]C(Nc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1。
